_comment: slab_decades4.json with a VOID gap: the same 100 cells over 10, the same four decades groups and 5x dense block over [4, 6], plus a void (materials/decades4_void.json's material 2, Sigma_t = 0 in every group) over [7, 8]. Pins -precon_ref_shift on a partly-void problem: every group is void in the same cells, so they share one reference, which is zero in the gap - the shift leaves the gap's pmat rows pure streaming (exactly the operator's rows there) and exact coverage (-precon_ref_k 4) is still the full pmat. Painted on cell boundaries.
